purpose: Targeted micro-remediation of V2.1's one remaining regression (OVERCONFIDENT_AMBIGUITY, 7->8 original / 0->1 remediation-validation) without damaging V2.1's genuine reference-accuracy gains. NOT a full dataset rebuild - additive only.
maskingVerification: 41/41 rows pass: prompt fully masked (-100), <|im_end|> supervised in every completion

leakageAudit.method: exact-text normalization + word-level Jaccard >=0.8, checked against v2/train, v2/validation, v2.1/train_additions, v2.1/validation_remediation (heldout intentionally excluded, never inspected)

hiddenContextAudit: Every 'resolvable' family's gold relies only on text visible within the SAME message (either explicit naming, or an antecedent named earlier in the same utterance followed by a backreference) - never a hidden proposal/candidate-list/conversation-history object, consistent with the real production prompt's single-turn architecture (no prior turns injected).
validationParaphraseAudit: Every family built from the high-level failure taxonomy (deictic-no-target / multiple-visible-targets / PT-switch-no-antecedent / exercise-no-antecedent / numeric-no-antecedent / correction-ambiguous-target / same-message-backreference / explicit-naming), never from a specific failing validation row's wording - verified via the leakage audit above (0 matches against any existing validation file).
heldoutStatus: HELDOUT_UNOPENED - never read, parsed, sampled, or derived from in this task.

familyDesign.boundary: bare deictic, zero antecedent anywhere in the visible text
familyDesign.note: Core A-case: no exercise/PT/plan/number named anywhere in the message, so the deictic word has nothing to bind to.

familyDesign.boundary: exactly two candidates named in the SAME message, singular deictic used without picking one
familyDesign.note: Genuine ambiguity visible entirely within the text itself - two real candidates, no disambiguation, not reliant on any hidden state.

familyDesign.boundary: PT-switch request with zero PT ever named in the message
familyDesign.note: Narrower, PT-specific sibling of family A - deliberately targets the exact OVERCONFIDENT_AMBIGUITY pattern seen on validation, with fresh wording (never 'PT đó/kia' from V2.1's own families, never the validation phrasing).

familyDesign.boundary: exercise-swap/removal request with zero exercise ever named in the message
numeric-adjustment request referring to an unlabeled number/level with none named in the message
familyDesign.note: Covers deictic reference to a quantity rather than an entity - same underlying boundary, different surface target type.

familyDesign.boundary: correction-shaped utterance with no identifiable field/entity target anywhere in the message
familyDesign.note: Extends the ambiguity boundary to CORRECT_INFORMATION-shaped text, not just REVISE_WORKFLOW-shaped - a distinct intent surface sharing the same underlying 'no antecedent' problem.

familyDesign.boundary: antecedent (squat/PT Minh/eat-clean) named earlier in the SAME message, deictic word refers back to it unambiguously
familyDesign.note: The key positive contrast: the referent is visible in text the model actually receives (no conversation history needed) - teaches resolution should happen when a real antecedent exists, directly preventing the family above from over-generalizing into never resolving anything.

familyDesign.boundary: item named directly, no deictic word at all - confirms confident action is still correct when there's no ambiguity to begin with
familyDesign.note: Baseline positive contrast - explicit naming needs no reference-resolution machinery at all; included so the model isn't pushed toward hedging on perfectly clear requests.

familyDesign.boundary: dev twin of family A, fresh wording
familyDesign.note: Dev-only, never trained on - tests whether the A-boundary generalizes.

familyDesign.boundary: dev twin of family C, fresh wording
familyDesign.note: Dev-only - directly tests the exact targeted OVERCONFIDENT_AMBIGUITY pattern with new phrasing.

familyDesign.boundary: dev twin of family B, fresh wording
dev twin of family G, fresh wording
familyDesign.note: Dev-only - tests whether the positive within-message-antecedent resolution survives alongside the negative families above.

familyDesign.boundary: dev twin of family H, fresh wording
dev twin of family E, fresh wording
